paragraphs.text: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
paragraphs.original: Ὀφείλομεν δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων βαστάζειν, καὶ μὴ ἑαυτοῖς ἀρέσκειν.
paragraphs.translit: Opheilomen de hēmeis hoi dynatoi ta asthenēmata tōn adynatōn bastazein, kai mē heautois areskein.

paragraphs.text: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, unto edifying.
paragraphs.original: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν τῷ πλησίον ἀρεσκέτω εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν·
paragraphs.translit: hekastos hēmōn tō plēsion aresketō eis to agathon pros oikodomēn·

paragraphs.text: For Christ also pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell upon me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτῷ ἤρεσεν· ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπʼ ἐμέ.
paragraphs.translit: kai gar ho Christos ouch heautō ēresen· alla kathōs gegraptai· Hoi oneidismoi tōn oneidizontōn se epepesan epʼ eme.

paragraphs.text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that through patience and through comfort of the scriptures we might have hope.
paragraphs.original: ὅσα γὰρ προεγράφη, εἰς τὴν ἡμετέραν διδασκαλίαν ἐγράφη, ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν τὴν ἐλπίδα ἔχωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: hosa gar proegraphē, eis tēn hēmeteran didaskalian egraphē, hina dia tēs hypomonēs kai dia tēs paraklēseōs tōn graphōn tēn elpida echōmen.

paragraphs.text: Now the God of patience and of comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν,
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos tēs hypomonēs kai tēs paraklēseōs dōē hymin to auto phronein en allēlois kata Christon Iēsoun,

paragraphs.text: that with one accord ye may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν θεὸν καὶ πατέρα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hina homothymadon en heni stomati doxazēte ton theon kai patera tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.
paragraphs.original: Διὸ προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ὑμᾶς, εἰς δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Dio proslambanesthe allēlous, kathōs kai ho Christos proselabeto hymas, eis doxan tou theou.

paragraphs.text: For I say that Christ hath been made a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises [given] unto the fathers,
paragraphs.original: λέγω γὰρ Χριστὸν διάκονον γεγενῆσθαι περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ ἀληθείας θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων,
paragraphs.translit: legō gar Christon diakonon gegenēsthai peritomēs hyper alētheias theou, eis to bebaiōsai tas epangelias tōn paterōn,

paragraphs.text: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.
paragraphs.original: τὰ δὲ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ ἐλέους δοξάσαι τὸν θεόν· καθὼς γέγραπται· Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσι, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.
paragraphs.translit: ta de ethnē hyper eleous doxasai ton theon· kathōs gegraptai· Dia touto exomologēsomai soi en ethnesi, kai tō onomati sou psalō.

paragraphs.text: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν λέγει· Εὐφράνθητε, ἔθνη, μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin legei· Euphranthēte, ethnē, meta tou laou autou.

paragraphs.text: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν· Αἰνεῖτε, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin· Aineite, panta ta ethnē, ton kyrion, kai epainesatōsan auton pantes hoi laoi.

paragraphs.text: And again, Isaiah saith, There shall be the root of Jesse, And he that ariseth to rule over the Gentiles; On him shall the Gentiles hope.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει· Ἔσται ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν· ἐπʼ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin Ēsaias legei· Estai hē rhiza tou Iessai, kai ho anistamenos archein ethnōn· epʼ autō ethnē elpiousin.

paragraphs.text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν, εἰς τὸ περισσεύειν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει πνεύματος ἁγίου.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos tēs elpidos plērōsai hymas pasēs charas kai eirēnēs en tō pisteuein, eis to perisseuein hymas en tē elpidi en dynamei pneumatos hagiou.

paragraphs.text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
paragraphs.original: Πέπεισμαι δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης, πεπληρωμένοι πάσης γνώσεως, δυνάμενοι καὶ ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Pepeismai de, adelphoi mou, kai autos egō peri hymōn, hoti kai autoi mestoi este agathōsynēs, peplērōmenoi pasēs gnōseōs, dynamenoi kai allēlous nouthetein.

paragraphs.text: But I write the more boldly unto you in some measure, as putting you again in remembrance, because of the grace that was given me of God,
paragraphs.original: τολμηρότερον δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἀπὸ μέρους, ὡς ἐπαναμιμνῄσκων ὑμᾶς, διὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ
paragraphs.translit: tolmēroteron de egrapsa hymin apo merous, hōs epanamimnēskōn hymas, dia tēn charin tēn dotheisan moi hypo tou theou

paragraphs.text: that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus unto the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τὸ εἶναί με λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἡγιασμένη ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: eis to einai me leitourgon Christou Iēsou eis ta ethnē, hierourgounta to euangelion tou theou, hina genētai hē prosphora tōn ethnōn euprosdektos, hēgiasmenē en pneumati hagiō.

paragraphs.text: I have therefore my glorifying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
paragraphs.original: ἔχω οὖν τὴν καύχησιν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν·
paragraphs.translit: echō oun tēn kauchēsin en Christō Iēsou ta pros ton theon·

paragraphs.text: For I will not dare to speak of any things save those which Christ wrought through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ τολμήσω τι λαλεῖν ὧν οὐ κατειργάσατο Χριστὸς διʼ ἐμοῦ εἰς ὑπακοὴν ἐθνῶν, λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ,
paragraphs.translit: ou gar tolmēsō ti lalein hōn ou kateirgasato Christos diʼ emou eis hypakoēn ethnōn, logō kai ergō,

paragraphs.text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round about even unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ;
paragraphs.original: ἐν δυνάμει σημείων καὶ τεράτων, ἐν δυνάμει πνεύματος· ὥστε με ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ κύκλῳ μέχρι τοῦ Ἰλλυρικοῦ πεπληρωκέναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: en dynamei sēmeiōn kai teratōn, en dynamei pneumatos· hōste me apo Ierousalēm kai kyklō mechri tou Illyrikou peplērōkenai to euangelion tou Christou,

paragraphs.text: yea, making it my aim so to preach the gospel, not where Christ was [already] named, that I might not build upon another man`s foundation;
paragraphs.original: οὕτως δὲ φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐχ ὅπου ὠνομάσθη Χριστός, ἵνα μὴ ἐπʼ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰκοδομῶ,
paragraphs.translit: houtōs de philotimoumenon euangelizesthai ouch hopou ōnomasthē Christos, hina mē epʼ allotrion themelion oikodomō,

paragraphs.text: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ ὄψονται, καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν.
paragraphs.translit: alla kathōs gegraptai· Hois ouk anēngelē peri autou opsontai, kai hoi ouk akēkoasin synēsousin.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:
paragraphs.original: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς·
paragraphs.translit: Dio kai enekoptomēn ta polla tou elthein pros hymas·

paragraphs.text: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τοῖς κλίμασι τούτοις, ἐπιποθίαν δὲ ἔχων τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν,
paragraphs.translit: nyni de mēketi topon echōn en tois klimasi toutois, epipothian de echōn tou elthein pros hymas apo hikanōn etōn,

paragraphs.text: whensoever I go unto Spain (for I hope to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first in some measure I shall have been satisfied with your company)--
paragraphs.original: ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν, ἐλπίζω γὰρ διαπορευόμενος θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς καὶ ὑφʼ ὑμῶν προπεμφθῆναι ἐκεῖ ἐὰν ὑμῶν πρῶτον ἀπὸ μέρους ἐμπλησθῶ—
paragraphs.translit: hōs an poreuōmai eis tēn Spanian, elpizō gar diaporeuomenos theasasthai hymas kai hyphʼ hymōn propemphthēnai ekei ean hymōn prōton apo merous emplēsthō—

paragraphs.text: but now, I [say], I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.
paragraphs.original: νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις.
paragraphs.translit: nyni de poreuomai eis Ierousalēm diakonōn tois hagiois.

paragraphs.text: For it hath been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints that are at Jerusalem.
paragraphs.original: εὐδόκησαν γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα κοινωνίαν τινὰ ποιήσασθαι εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
paragraphs.translit: eudokēsan gar Makedonia kai Achaia koinōnian tina poiēsasthai eis tous ptōchous tōn hagiōn tōn en Ierousalēm.

paragraphs.text: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it [to them] also to minister unto them in carnal things.
paragraphs.original: εὐδόκησαν γάρ, καὶ ὀφειλέται εἰσὶν αὐτῶν· εἰ γὰρ τοῖς πνευματικοῖς αὐτῶν ἐκοινώνησαν τὰ ἔθνη, ὀφείλουσιν καὶ ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: eudokēsan gar, kai opheiletai eisin autōn· ei gar tois pneumatikois autōn ekoinōnēsan ta ethnē, opheilousin kai en tois sarkikois leitourgēsai autois.

paragraphs.text: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο οὖν ἐπιτελέσας, καὶ σφραγισάμενος αὐτοῖς τὸν καρπὸν τοῦτον, ἀπελεύσομαι διʼ ὑμῶν εἰς Σπανίαν·
paragraphs.translit: touto oun epitelesas, kai sphragisamenos autois ton karpon touton, apeleusomai diʼ hymōn eis Spanian·

paragraphs.text: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.
paragraphs.original: οἶδα δὲ ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ ἐλεύσομαι.
paragraphs.translit: oida de hoti erchomenos pros hymas en plērōmati eulogias Christou eleusomai.

paragraphs.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ πρὸς τὸν θεόν,
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō de hymas, adelphoi, dia tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou kai dia tēs agapēs tou pneumatos synagōnisasthai moi en tais proseuchais hyper emou pros ton theon,

paragraphs.text: that I may be delivered from them that are disobedient in Judaea, and [that] my ministration which [I have] for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις γένηται,
paragraphs.translit: hina rhysthō apo tōn apeithountōn en tē Ioudaia kai hē diakonia mou hē eis Ierousalēm euprosdektos tois hagiois genētai,

paragraphs.text: that I may come unto you in joy through the will of God, and together with you find rest.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ἐν χαρᾷ ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hina en chara elthōn pros hymas dia thelēmatos theou synanapausōmai hymin.

paragraphs.text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos tēs eirēnēs meta pantōn hymōn· amēn.
